liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Feel Like a Stranger** (1 review): Brent and Jerry attempt an a cappella chorus, singing in soprano range [6]

## The recordings

- **gd80-03-31.senn.barbella.4741.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 17 songs; 127 min; rated 2.67/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: Clear and clean sound, slightly lean low end, minimal near-field ambient noise [7]
- **gd1980-03-31.151425.fob.senn421.cm.eaton.miller.t.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 126 min [2]. Said about its sound: Issues in first set; loud noise from a head during Brown Eyed Women [16]
- **gd1980-03-31.151345.senn421.eaton.miller.flac2496**: source not stated; 17 songs; 126 min [3]
- **gd1980-03-31.164195.set2.aud.lamarre.miller.flac2448**: audience recording; 9 songs; 76 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- An usher yells at someone to leave a seat that is not theirs [9]
- Lost Sailor and Saint of Circumstance are missing from this recording [10]
- Security shouts at a fan to leave the venue for lacking a ticket [11]
- Recognized as having the first performance of Feel Like a Stranger [13]
- Cold, frosty evening in Passaic; tickets scarce, expensive, and hard to afford [14]
- Smallest venue where the reviewer saw the Grateful Dead perform [2]
- The jam is short and inferior to versions from August and September 1980 [6]
- Lacks the depth and energy of shows performed later in 1980 [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd80-03-31.senn.barbella.4741.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Rob Eaton; source: Audience Recording: Sennnheiser 421 [1]. Also: Technical difficulties occurred mid-show; taping required covert gear and careful level setting; Single source tape paused frequently; received as a brown-bag trade in low generation [12][13]
- **gd1980-03-31.151425.fob.senn421.cm.eaton.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Recorded, Transferred and Mastered by Rob Eaton; transferred by Additional Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 29, 2020; source: (FOB) Sennheiser 421 > Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550) [2]. Also: Tape fades out cutting Saint of Circumstance; distortion at start of Don't Ease Me In [2]
- **gd1980-03-31.151345.senn421.eaton.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Recorded, Transferred and Mastered by Rob Eaton Additional Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 29, 2020; source: (FOB) Sennheiser 421 > Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550) [3]
- **gd1980-03-31.164195.set2.aud.lamarre.miller.flac2448**: taped by From Doug Lamarre; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  March 31, 2023; source: Set 2 Cassette From Doug Lamarre (Maxell UDXLII-C90/Dolby B) [4]
